# Merge

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Merge multiple objects into one (think Object.assign).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/merge",
  "type": "MergeOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/merge').par.objects` (an input) and `op('/merge').out.object` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.objects`, `out.object`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `objects` | `ListField` | `[]` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `object` | `DataField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
